name: qfd_d2d_static_r1-r1-COMMIT
purpose: Q-LINK static D2D link end qfd_d2d_static (compiler calendars, 583-bit PHY word slot link with 4x137 SRAM store, explicit recovery mode; no credits/backpressure). PHY on face S.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_d2d_static u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/split_20261014/ot_qwen_crc_parallel.sv rtl/qwen_sys/split_20261014/ot_qwen_static_slot_link.sv rtl/qwen_sys/split_20261014/ot_qkvd_d2d_llr.sv rtl/qwen_sys/split_20261014/qkd_native_attention_record.sv rtl/qwen_sys/d2d_static_20261015/ot_qwen_d2d_static.sv rtl/qwen_sys/d2d_static_20261015/ot_qwen_d2d_services.sv rtl/qwen_sys/d2d_static_20261015/ot_qwen_d2d_dies.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_kvn_static_transport.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_d2d_static_r1/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_d2d_static_r1/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_d2d_static_r1 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_d2d_static --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
